    Anchored families of every infinite size #

    For every infinite cardinal κ there is an anchored family of Kronecker bricks over an index type of cardinality κ whose anchor and constituents have dimension at most κ (Bricks.exists_anchored). Gluing over subsets of the index type then gives the rigid families of Göbel and Simson (KroneckerBricks/RigidFamily.lean).

    • κ ≤ |k|: the bricks T_Λ for pairwise disjoint countable sets Λ ⊆ k (Bricks.setAnchored).
    • κ > |k| regular: the transport pool of a rigid map system on κ (Bricks.transportPool).
    • κ > |k| singular: the marked transports of the rigid map systems on cofinal regular cardinals κ_i < κ, along disjoint countable parts of one pool, as in the proof of Bricks.exists_brick_singular.
